title: Coordinate duplication of a family
statement: Let $F$ assign a real-valued function on $\mathbb F_2^n$ to each point of the $k$-dimensional cube, choose a coordinate $i$ and a bit $b\in\mathbb F_2$. Define a new family by replacing coordinate $i$ of each cube point by $b$ before evaluating $F$.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a family indexed by the $k$-dimensional cube, with values in real-valued functions on $\mathbb F_2^n$
$i$ is a coordinate among the $k$ coordinates
